source_text: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) 2012 policy, reaffirmed in subsequent reviews, concludes that these cumulative benefits—encompassing UTI prevention, STI reduction, and lower cancer risk—outweigh procedural risks in newborns, supporting informed parental decision-making without universal recommendation. [21]
